title: Cyber Aware ca04 trailer, round 1 (narrow-panel takes for the builder, landed panel and inbox; render 9:16 and 1:1 from this file)

script.heading: ca04 trailer script (Executive impersonation)
script.brief: See docs/video/scripts/ca04_trailer_script.md (round 1 after review) and docs/video/takes_ca04.md (recorded 23 Nov, commit 9f3f93264). Model ca01 (attack-first). Marks-based windows from the recorded takes; Sulafat VO; PeaceFolk Guitar Motif window from 55.126 s. The hook is the owner-question placeholder (reply cold open).

spoiler.note: t02n: reply-in 44.11, hook-start 44.11 (+0.15 = in), window 44.26 to 49.26 (5.0 s): green It landed panel about 0.8 s, Done pressed 44.98, Tomas's reply 'Will do, Catherine. I'll get it sorted and drop you a line once it's done. Safe travels.' readable 45.05, hook-end 49.35; silent, the reply is the game's own on-screen text so no burned caption (it would double the text); flip hazard frames start 49.37, after the window; Red flags text and Advisory hidden by CSS; PLACEHOLDER hook, owner question 1 | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t04n run A: list-up 1.75, in 2.0 is after the Inbox intro panel (rules text at 1 s), list held still to 10.94, out 8.8; five rows, '0 of 5 sorted', voicemail rows show Catherine Merrin's name; no row opened, nothing pressed; 760 px client | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks
Attack chapter card, title only | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t02: Events & talks page up from about 12.0 (after Our people, Tomas noted 9.58), calendar block noted 13.15, bio block noted 15.10, browser-closed 17.26 (frame at 17.0 is already the next panel, out 16.6 is before it); public facts only (Catherine's trip, the Lisbon Design Forum). Contact-sheet read only: frame-check the in point for a page-switch frame (the contact sheet at 12 s shows the Events page loaded) | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t02n: slot1 menu opens about 26.2 and the From name is chosen (slot1 mark 27.86); out is before the slot2 menu (about 29.6); pretext set earlier (closed drop-down), Red flags text hidden by CSS (counter number only) | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t02n: slot3 menu (the trip, 'the Lisbon Design Forum') opens about 32.7, slot3 chosen 34.83, counter 3; the shot ends at 35.65 where the lands shot begins (before redflags-final 35.93), v4b 'Tie it to her trip' plays over the open trip menu; THIN SCROLLBAR on the panel's right edge from about 33 s: the 9:16 and 1:1 crops (cx 0.462 / 0.339, zoom 1) drop it, check on the render that the crop edge hides no panel text | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t02n: send 37.6, landed panel at 37.66 (green It landed panel: He would open it / It reads as his boss / Fits a trip he knows she is on, pattern level), the Send click falls 1.95 s into the shot so v5 ends just after it and v6 'It landed.' plays on the panel; out is before reply-in 44.11 and before the mail client closes (49.5), so nothing repeats in the hook | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t02n: flip-up 49.51; the unhidden debrief panel ('Your message', red-flag bullets) shows on frames 49.37 to 49.5, so in is 49.6 (heading only from about 49.53); out 51.6 is before end 52.31; 'Now you're the PA' heading and strip only (body hidden by CSS) | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks
